verdict.rationale: Daytona has no built-in natural-language interface of its own. It does ship an official MCP server and an agent skill, so supported AI agents (Claude, Cursor, Windsurf) can operate its sandboxes, which lets users drive Daytona through natural language in those agents. missing for 10: a first-party natural-language command interface within the product itself, documentation of which sandbox operations the MCP server exposes, and hands-on or independent corroboration of natural-language operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Daytona Model Context Protocol (MCP) server enables AI agents to interact with Daytona Sandboxes programmatically.
Initialize the MCP server with your preferred AI agent. Supported agents include Claude, Cursor, and Windsurf.
An agent skill for creating and running sandboxes on the Daytona platform.
